lane: interactive 2D environment planning; no runtime implementation in this packet
plant_rule: root pinned, independent existing alpha; no artwork duplicated under moving layer
path_rule: left cross-screen connector and descending approach excluded from plant/texture deformation
water_rule: only water UVs/highlights move; never sample shoreline/castle via screen-space distortion
geometry_rule: castle architecture, stained glass, bridge, stones, path remain fixed
pause_rule: all ambient timers and interactions pause; focus loss/back cancels transients; no per-frame save writes
save_rule: ambient phase unsaved; new interactions require existing state owner, defaults and intentional input
grok_output: reference only, no automatic video-to-atlas or cinematic delivery
memory_budget: provisional: <=8 MiB incremental resident texture budget; measure mipmaps/overdraw on device
fallback: static accepted art with ambient effects disabled
character_authorities: not applicable: no character animation or voice generation jobs; portrait stays fixed
deferred: castle reflection until a painted footprint is designed
door opening until hinge/interior/contact states are prepared
foreground branch articulation until separate leaf groups and hidden areas are clean
